omniwatermask.assumptions: Zero-training optical baseline for the trained U-Net (Component B). Optical-only; not usable under cloud during an active storm. Agreement (IoU) with the U-Net's MNDWI labels is a sanity check, not an accuracy claim.

encroachment.assumptions: ChangeStar detects BUILT-UP change between two real Sentinel-2 dates, not floodwater. 'Encroachment' = new built-up intersecting the flood susceptibility surface. Development-pressure indicator only; non-operational, not an official warning.
